target_statement: Future Gate4 should test whether a candidate can maintain and update hidden partner-relevant state under uncertainty, use it for counterfactual partner prediction and action under distribution shift, and degrade under real interventions in ways faithful shortcut baselines cannot match.

evidence_targets.requirement: Candidate must infer latent partner-relevant state from partial observations without answer-bearing visible labels or target fields.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: visible or serialized fields make target directly decodable

evidence_targets.requirement: Candidate behavior must depend on update history and degrade under freeze-memory or remove-update ablations.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: static belief table, pair count, or observation-only baseline ties candidate

evidence_targets.requirement: Candidate must recompute predictions under counterfactual partner interventions not present as trace fragments.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: ngram trace lookup or nearest-neighbor trace retrieval ties candidate

evidence_targets.requirement: Heldout split must include unseen partner dynamics or causal families, not only unseen labels within the same toy family.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: candidate advantage disappears or baseline tie occurs on unseen families

evidence_targets.requirement: Ablations must rerun episodes under real interventions on social/partner update, memory update, counterfactual branch, partner identity, and observation order.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: claimed update path can be removed without meaningful degradation or ablation does not rerun behavior

evidence_targets.requirement: Candidate must be evaluated under shifted observation/outcome mappings and shifted partner dynamics with schema parity across splits.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: schema split or episode-order artifact exposes the shift

evidence_targets.requirement: Replay must recompute candidate and baseline behavior from serialized_state plus observation and record producer_function, input artifacts, run_id, seed, context IDs, episode IDs, aggregation rule, and code path hash.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: stored actions, cached outputs, stored metrics, or hash-only replay can pass

evidence_targets.requirement: Serialized-state decoder, full-bundle decoder, lookup, n-gram, pair-count, static-belief, nearest-neighbor, random/majority, and oracle-style upper-bound baselines must be callable and invoked.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: any faithful non-oracle baseline ties or beats candidate

evidence_targets.requirement: The future task card must predeclare blocked verdicts for baseline equivalence, leakage, replay weakness, unused frozen inputs, unfair baseline access, and claim inflation.
evidence_targets.negative_evidence_stop: task tries to repair after baseline tie rather than preserving negative evidence

future_provenance_requirements.reported_result: must be produced by callable computation path
future_provenance_requirements.ablation: must rerun episodes under real interventions
future_provenance_requirements.contrast: must be computed from declared splits and artifacts
future_provenance_requirements.leakage: scanner must include at least one positive-control case
future_provenance_requirements.replay: must recompute behavior from serialized_state plus observation

claim_ceiling: future Gate4 evidence-target specification only; no execution or mechanism claim
